{"access":"read_only","command":"/Users/jiangtao/Desktop/open-harness/apps/desktop/resources/workspace-runtime/node/bin/node -e 'const fs=require(\"node:fs\"); const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"outputs/continuity.json\",\"utf8\")); if (JSON.stringify(d.refund_ids)!==JSON.stringify([\"R301\",\"R302\",\"R303\"])) throw Error(\"refund_ids mismatch\"); for (const k of [\"applied_refund\",\"net_received\",\"unpaid_before_refunds\"]) if (typeof d[k]!==\"number\") throw Error(k+\" must be numeric\"); if (d.applied_refund!==60 || d.net_received!==415 || d.unpaid_before_refunds!==225) throw Error(\"numeric result mismatch\"); if (!Array.isArray(d.evidence) || !d.evidence.some(s=>s.includes(\"CORRECTION-ORCHID\") && s.includes(\"event-4\") && s.includes(\"R303 已经人工核实为 settled\"))) throw Error(\"correction citation mismatch\"); if (!d.evidence.some(s=>s.includes(\"rules.md\") && s.includes(\"valid payments 475\") && s.includes(\"applied refunds 60\"))) throw Error(\"calculation evidence mismatch\"); console.log(JSON.stringify({parseable:true,refund_ids:d.refund_ids,applied_refund:d.applied_refund,net_received:d.net_received,unpaid_before_refunds:d.unpaid_before_refunds,evidence_count:d.evidence.length,citations_consistent:true},null,2));'","timeout_seconds":20,"yield_time_ms":10000}
